After a nonzero physical pivot in exact rank three, if a residual physical row is isotropic for the residual Schur form, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 4*66^(1/4)[h ell |det Lambda| |a|]^(-1/4).

For an indefinite residual Schur form B with Delta=-det B, a residual row of leverage h and normalized Schur Rayleigh beta satisfying |beta|>=sqrt(Delta)/5 yields a determinant-scale residual L3 bound and hence an explicit full rank-three L-infinity bound after outer square smoothing.
